source.baseStandard:
1. 성상 : 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 점박이가 있는 노란 하양색 또는 흰 노랑색의 장방형 제피 정제
2. 판토텐산 : 표시량(200mg/1000mg)의 80~180%
3. 비타민C : 표시량(50mg/1000mg)의 80~150%
4. 비타민E : 표시량(5.5㎎α-TE/1000mg)의 80~150%
5. 비타민D : 표시량(3μg/1000mg)의 80~180%
6. 나이아신 : 표시량(7.5mg NE/1000mg)의 80~150%
7. 아연 : 표시량(2.55mg/1000mg)의 80~150%
8. 셀렌 : 표시량(27.5μg/1000mg)의 80~150%
9. 비타민B12 : 표시량(2.4μg/1000mg)의 80~180%
10. 붕해도 : 60분 이내
11. 대장균군 : 음성

이 제품은 나이아신 7.5mg, 비타민 B12 2.4μg, 비타민 C 50mg, 비타민 D 3μg, 비타민 E 5.5mg, 셀레늄 27.5μg, 아연 2.55mg, 판토텐산 200mg를 표시량으로 담은 8원료 복합 건강기능식품입니다. 각 원료의 공식 인정 기능성은 아래와 같습니다.

  • 1일 1회(1정) 섭취로 나이아신 7.5mg, 비타민 B12 2.4μg, 비타민 C 50mg, 비타민 D 3μg, 비타민 E 5.5mg, 셀레늄 27.5μg, 아연 2.55mg, 판토텐산 200mg

Health Functional FoodNiacin 7.5mgVitamin B12 2.4μgVitamin C 50mgVitamin D 3μgVitamin E 5.5mgSelenium 27.5μgZinc 2.55mgPantothenic acid 200mgOnce a day

테트라포스 판토텐산Niacin · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc · Pantothenic acid

Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주) · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 7.5mg of Niacin, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 50mg of Vitamin C, 3μg of Vitamin D, 5.5mg of Vitamin E, 27.5μg of Selenium, 2.55mg of Zinc, 200mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 7.5mg Niacin, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 50mg Vitamin C, 3μg Vitamin D, 5.5mg Vitamin E, 27.5μg Selenium, 2.55mg Zinc, 200mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (7.5mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin C labelled (50mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (3μg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (5.5mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (27.5μg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (2.55mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (200mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 점박이가 있는 노란 하양색 또는 흰 노랑색의 장방형 제피 정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 실온보관 / 1)직사광선이나 고온다습한 곳을 피하여 청결하고 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.2)영･유아 및 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
